title: Figure 2: Distribution of Evaluations of Object, Unit, and All Sightings for All Years
description: Concentric pie chart with hatched and shaded wedges showing sighting evaluation categories: Astronomical (479 = 21.8%), Aircraft (474 = 21.5%), Balloon (339 = 15.4%), Insufficient info (240 = 10.9%), Other (233 = 10.3%) and Unknown (434 = 19.7%) for object sightings. Outer rings give the corresponding counts for unit sightings (2554) and all sightings (3201). Caption reads "FIGURE 2 DISTRIBUTION OF EVALUATIONS OF OBJECT, UNIT, AND ALL SIGHTINGS FOR ALL YEARS"; drawing A-7480, page 18.
